name: Mercury
fun_fact: Mercury has no atmosphere to retain heat, so its surface temperature varies wildly between day and night.

name: Venus
fun_fact: Venus spins backward compared to most planets, so the Sun rises in the west and sets in the east.

name: Earth
fun_fact: Earth is the only planet known to support life and has liquid water covering most of its surface.

name: Mars
fun_fact: Mars has the tallest volcano in the solar system, Olympus Mons, which is about three times taller than Mount Everest.

name: Jupiter
fun_fact: Jupiter is so massive that it could contain more than 1,300 Earths inside it.

name: Saturn
fun_fact: Saturn's rings are made of ice and rock and extend thousands of kilometers from the planet.

name: Uranus
fun_fact: Uranus rotates on its side, making its poles face the Sun for long periods during its orbit.

name: Neptune
fun_fact: Neptune has the strongest winds in the solar system, with speeds over 2,000 kilometers per hour.
